ios.desc:
"This is doodling for digital natives . . . mind blowing." — Wired Magazine

"Uzu for iPad is endlessly complicated, simply fun." — Ars Technica

Uzu is a generative design playground — a math-physics-art toy for anyone who ever loved spirographs, fireworks, planetariums, lava lamps, light painting, kaleidoscopes, or graphing calculators. Touch the screen and watch thousands of particles swirl, spiral, and bloom in real time. Change the entire feel by simply changing how many fingers you use.

Relax. Play. Meditate. Create wallpapers. Or lose yourself for an hour tweaking symmetry, animation modes, and effects. Uzu is endlessly deep and simply fun.

Now completely rebuilt with a native Metal engine and a beautiful SwiftUI interface — smoother, richer, and more powerful than ever.

FEATURES
• Fully dynamic generative particle system
• 21 animation modes for each touch count (0 through 10)
• Rotational, translational, and reflective symmetry
• 122 factory presets plus unlimited user presets
• 10 visual effects: Glow, Warp, Kaleidoscope, Sparkle, Feedback, Color, Gradient, Pixelate, Scanlines, and Vignette
• Export and import presets — save, share, and back up your creations
• Fast preset switching, shake to hide the menu, adjustable quality settings
• Freeze mode, microphone reactivity, and thousands of possible combinations
• Create stunning backgrounds for iPhone and iPad

ACCLAIM
• Winner of Apple's "App of the Week"
• Apple Rewind: Best Generative Art and Sound App
• Reached #1 on the App Store
• Featured in Apple's "App Store Essentials Hall of Fame"
• Seen in the "Year of the iPad" video at the iPad keynote
• Featured as an Apple Staff Favorite

SUPPORT
Questions or stories? We'd love to hear from you.
